sobre_mi.title: About me
sobre_mi.subtitle: Senior backend engineer based in Buenos Aires. Open to remote roles in UTC-3.

bio.paragraph1: I'm Sebastián, a tech lead and senior backend engineer based in Buenos Aires. I've spent the last decade writing software that runs in production — mostly in banking, fintech and data platforms, where a bug isn't a 500 but a blocked transaction or a regulatory report that ships late.
bio.paragraph2: I'm comfortable across the full cycle: from technical decisions (which database, which consistency model, what SLA is realistic) to operations (runbooks, on-call rotation, post-mortems that actually help). I particularly enjoy projects where the complexity lives in the domain — fraud, scoring, event ingestion — rather than in the framework.
bio.paragraph3: I'm currently open to fully remote roles in the UTC-3 timezone and medium/long-term engagements. If you need someone to take ownership of an existing system and leave it better than they found it, let's talk.

skills.title: Skills
skills.soft: Tech leadership and mentoring of squads of 3-6 people. Heavy collaboration with risk, compliance and product teams to translate business constraints into technical decisions. Blameless post-mortems and operational documentation as part of the codebase.
